scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,dump,kit "pnpm --filter @repo/orpc dev" "pnpm --filter @repo/api dev" "pnpm --filter @repo/dump dev" "pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit dev"
scripts.dev:kit: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && concurrently --kill-others "pnpm --filter @repo/orpc dev" "pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit dev"
scripts.cloudflare:build: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir ../../.cloudflare/api && wrangler deploy -c apps/dump/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run --outdir ../../.cloudflare/dump
scripts.cloudflare:dev: pnpm cloudflare:migrate:local && pnpm --filter @repo/orpc build && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,dump,kit "pnpm --filter @repo/orpc dev" "wrangler dev -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --inspector-port 9230 --persist-to .cloudflare/state" "wrangler dev -c apps/dump/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --inspector-port 9231 --persist-to .cloudflare/state" "DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare pnpm --filter heyttpdump-kit exec vite --port 8789 --strictPort"
scripts.cloudflare:preview: pnpm cloudflare:migrate:local && pnpm cloudflare:build && concurrently --kill-others -n api,dump,kit "wrangler dev -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --inspector-port 9230 --persist-to .cloudflare/state" "wrangler dev -c apps/dump/wrangler.jsonc --port 8788 --inspector-port 9231 --persist-to .cloudflare/state" "wrangler dev -c apps/kit/wrangler.jsonc --port 8789 --inspector-port 9232 --persist-to .cloudflare/state"
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --local --persist-to .cloudflare/state
scripts.cloudflare:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm cloudflare:build && wrangler deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/dump/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy -c apps/kit/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:test: pnpm build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && pnpm cloudflare:dry-run && node --test tests/cloudflare/*.test.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @repo/orpc --filter @repo/api --filter @repo/dump build && pnpm -r check && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && node --test tests/dist/*.test.js
